title: Looking for a spooky night out? Rhode Island has 2 top ghost tours
excerpt: USA TODAY named two Rhode Island ghost tours as some of the best in the country. Here's why.
content:
Oct. 1, 2026, 5:15 a.m. ET

Not one, but two of the best ghost tours in the country are in Rhode Island.

In USA TODAY's 10BEST Readers' Choice Award 2026 Halloween awards both Providence Ghost Tour at No. 2 and Seaside Shadows Haunted History Tours at No. 8. in the ghost tour category. The winners are chosen by a public vote after being nominated by industry experts.

Here's how to go on Rhode Island's top-rated ghost tours this spooky season.

About Providence Ghost Tour

This Providence-based attraction leads 90-minute tours through the historic East Side of the city. While guides lead the tour group through the dark shadows of university campuses by lantern light, they tell stories of Providence's most famous ghostly figures, including everyone from servants to famous authors.

The tour constantly changes with the city's ghost scene to offer something new, and each new ghost story undergoes extensive historical and paranormal research before its debut to guarantee authenticity, according to the website.

While the regular Providence Ghost Tour is the most popular option, other tours offered include Haunted Benefit Street and Parasols and Pocket Watches.

Tickets for the city's ghost tour cost $27 for adults, $15 for children ages 13 and under or $25 for seniors and military personnel. The tour is offered daily at 7 p.m., leaving from 60 Congdon St. in Providence.

About Seaside Shadows Haunted History Tour

Seaside Shadows, the No. 8 for ghost tours, offers historic tours of two ghost-infested waterfront towns: Westerly and Mystic, Connecticut.

The downtown Westerly ghost tour explores tales of ghosts along the banks of the Pawcatuck River, including stories of deadly shipwrecks, cursed pirate treasure and trapped souls of the 19th century industrial community. Meanwhile, the Mystic ghost tour tells the story of legends and war heroes through the historic downtown landscape.

Here's what USA TODAY said about the favorite Halloween attraction: "The storied shores of New England can be discovered firsthand thanks to Seaside Shadows Haunted History Tours, which blends history with the occult on guided tours across both Mystic, Connecticut, and Westerly, Rhode Island. While options span from downtown walking excursions to spirit-themed pub crawls, each individual tour is united through a common affinity for the paranormal world."

Tickets cost $30 every month except October, when they cost $35. Seaside Shadows' Rhode Island ghost tours take place at 7 p.m. every Friday through Sunday, while the Mystic tours are offered daily at 4 p.m. and 7 p.m. A full schedule for all tours can be found online.

What other ghost tours made the list?

Here is USA TODAY's full ranking of the top 10 ghost tours in the country:

  1. Black Cat Tours – Salem, MA
  2. Providence Ghost Tour – Providence, RI
  3. Sisters Grimm Ghost Tours – San Antonio, TX
  4. Savannah History & Haunts – Savannah, GA
  5. Ghosts & Gravestones – Multiple locations
  6. The Original Ghost Tours – Williamsburg, VA
  7. Madame Morbid's Trolley Tours – Brooklyn, NY
  8. Seaside Shadows Haunted History Tours – Mystic, CT and Westerly, RI
  9. Ghosts of Gettysburg – Gettysburg, PA
  10. Old Bisbee Ghost Tour – Bisbee, AZ
